notes.title: Seen Update 15
notes.content:
Seen Update 15

Hi everyone,

Seen Update 15:

- Improved Checkpoints system.
- Added the ability to load game from previous Checkpoints (Load menu).
- Holding "+" button speed up game by 4X (use to escape long cut-scenes or any slow part).
- Reduced game size from 3gb to less than 1gb.
- Updated game engine to 4.26
- Fixed windowed mode and other resolution settings problems.
- Fixed game stuck at loading
- Other minor improvements 


- Changed the current ending to "End of Part one" because we are planning to release "Seen 2" in the near future. And "Seen 2" will be a sequel to Seen.
Note: We are planning to contact Valve and ask them if they could give Seen 2 for free to all current Seen owners.

You could wishlist Seen 2 from here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1695530/Seen_2/


Thank you.
